acceptICMP.description: Accept all ICMP traffic (path MTU discovery).
acceptICMP.title: acceptICMP

acceptICMPv6.description: Accept all ICMPv6 traffic (IPv6 neighbour discovery).
acceptICMPv6.title: acceptICMPv6

containerRuntimeEndpoint.description:
Path to the CRI socket, relative to `host.prefix`. Defaults to containerd;
set `/run/crio/crio.sock` on CRI-O.
containerRuntimeEndpoint.title: containerRuntimeEndpoint

extraArgs.description: Additional arguments passed to the controller.
extraArgs.title: extraArgs

logLevel.description: zap log level (higher is more verbose).
logLevel.title: logLevel

networkPlugins.description:
Comma-separated CNI plugins whose net-attach-defs are enforced (the
upstream deploy manifest enables macvlan and ipvlan).
networkPlugins.title: networkPlugins

enabled.description:
Create and mount the custom-rule ConfigMaps (common rules applied to every
policy; the files are read once at controller start).
enabled.title: enabled

ipv4.default: # Add custom IPv4 rules here if needed
ipv4.description: Custom IPv4 ingress and egress rules.
ipv4.title: ipv4

ipv6.default: # Add custom IPv6 rules here if needed
ipv6.description: Custom IPv6 ingress and egress rules.
ipv6.title: ipv6

global.description: Global values are values that can be accessed from any chart or subchart by exactly the same name.
global.title: global

path.description: Host root filesystem path mounted at `host.prefix`.
path.title: path

prefix.description:
Prefix under which the host root filesystem is mounted; the controller
reads the CRI socket and pod network namespaces beneath it.
prefix.title: prefix

image.description:
Default values for multi-networkpolicy-nftables; the controller that enforces
MultiNetworkPolicy on secondary (net-attach-def) interfaces with nftables.
The MultiNetworkPolicy CRD ships unmodified from upstream in the chart's crds/
directory (see the README).

tag.description: Overrides the image tag; defaults to the chart appVersion.
tag.title: tag

image.title: image

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for private registries.
imagePullSecrets.title: imagePullSecrets

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.
nameOverride.title: nameOverride

podSecurityContext.description:
Pod-level securityContext (the controller enters pod network namespaces and
must run as root on the host network).
podSecurityContext.title: podSecurityContext

priorityClassName.description:
Priority class name for pod scheduling (node infrastructure: must not be
evicted from any node).
priorityClassName.title: priorityClassName

create.description: Create the ClusterRole/ClusterRoleBinding (rules mirror the upstream deploy.yaml).
create.title: create

securityContext.description:
Container securityContext (privileged: the controller uses setns and writes
nftables rules inside pod network namespaces).
securityContext.title: securityContext

automount.description: Automount the API token (on by default: the controller watches the cluster API).
automount.title: automount

name.description: ServiceAccount name; generated from the release name if empty.
name.title: name

tolerations.description:
Tolerations for pod scheduling (defaults keep the DaemonSet on
critical-addons-only nodes).
tolerations.title: tolerations
